issues.title: Ops Dashboard Refresh 失败：Git 推送失败
issues.evidence:
gh workflow run "Post-deploy Tasks" || echo "Deploy trigger failed (non-fatal)"
error: failed to push some refs to 'https://github.com/fys2388/chinaboundtravel'
##[error]Process completed with exit code 1.
issues.recommended_action: Git 推送失败，通常是并发冲突。检查是否有其他 workflow 同时推送，添加 rebase 容错。
